messages:
anya: quick non-work question — imagine we had a communal 'mystery snack drawer' in the office. you can hide ONE snack for emergency morale boosts. what do you stash? rules: one item, label it, and no takebacks. go.

mike: Trader Joe's dark chocolate-covered espresso beans. tiny but lethal meeting fuel. :coffee::chocolate_bar:

devon: salted licorice. don't @ me. perfect for 2am debugging. :sunglasses:

sara: homemade kimchi in an airtight mason jar (i will label it). it will smell glorious and terrifying. :fire:

ops-bot: FYI: please follow food policy — put perishables in the fridge or label with name + date.

mike: @sara please not next to the whiteboard markers tho :grimacing:

anya: OK low-key compromise: tiny jerky sticks OR emergency gummy bears. who’s team sweet vs savory? :thinking_face:

sam: emergency supply = single-serve Nutella + spoon. solves all sadness. :chocolate_bar::spoon:

devon: glass container rec strongly advised. plastic jars become science projects in 6 weeks.

jen: i'll bring individually wrapped peppermints — diplomatic and low-risk. :seedling:

anya: labeling format suggestion (copy/paste):
```
Name — 2026-03-23
```

ops-bot: Note: perishable items left unlabeled for >48h will be moved to the fridge or tossed.

anya: OK tiny poll — react with one emoji below to claim your stash: :chocolate_bar: espresso beans, :gummy_bears: gummy bears, :nutella: Nutella, :mint: peppermints, :shrug: surprise me.

mike: :chocolate_bar:

sara: :shrug: (if kimchi is allowed, i'll take responsibility)

devon: :gummy_bears:

anya: awesome. i'll make a little sign for the drawer and a label sheet. thanks team :)

ops-bot: Logged: snack-drawer-thread 1718888888 — reminder set for 48h check.
